recommendation_title: Prioritize Billing/Support: Fix Premium Feature Lock-In
recommendation: Billing/support should be the top focus next quarter, driven primarily by ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS, which alone accounts for 58,940 complaints [C001] and a severity sum of 174,087 [C002] — the single highest-priority issue in the entire dataset, nearly matching the whole billing_support area's severity sum of 204,819. Customers describe being blocked from basic playback controls (seek, repeat, song selection) unless they pay for Premium, a confusion/frustration pattern distinct from simple outages. While access (ISS-ACCESS-LOGIN, mean severity 3.900112 [C027]) and playback (crashes/skips) show higher per-complaint severity, billing/support's issue delivers the largest combined volume and severity impact, making it the clearest lever for next-quarter effort.

alternatives.title: Access (login failures)
alternatives.why_not_first: Access has the highest mean severity in the pack (3.838968 area-level; 3.900112 for ISS-ACCESS-LOGIN [C027]) but far lower volume, with only 12,749 area complaints and 8,029 for the login issue [C025], limiting its overall priority_score versus billing/support's leading issue [C004].

alternatives.title: Usability (ads, redesign, library)
alternatives.why_not_first: Usability has the highest area complaint_count (75,230) but its top issue, ads (ISS-USABILITY-ADS), has a lower priority_score of 85,318 [C012] than the billing issue's 174,087 [C004], and lower mean severity (2.280864 [C011]) overall.

alternatives.title: Playback (stops/skips, crashes)
alternatives.why_not_first: Playback has high sev4plus counts (11,374 area-level) and severe individual issues like ISS-PLAYBACK-STOPS_SKIPS (mean severity 3.185217 [C015]), but its top issue's priority_score of 44,042 [C016] trails well behind the billing issue's 174,087 [C004].
